profile_text: As a leading tour operator, this company specializes in crafting unique travel packages and holidays to diverse destinations, driving its remarkable 7750% growth since its baseline. With a focus on tailored travel experiences, it has expanded its workforce to 157 employees in 2024, solidifying its position in the administrative and support service activities sector. By catering to the evolving demands of the travel market, the company has achieved significant scaling, earning its classification as a Scaler.
